# Section-2 `axes` sidecar - census and cross-check

**Generated by `tools/agx-isa/axes_sidecar.py` (driven by `dashboards.py`); do not hand-edit.**

Section 2 requires every field to carry independent status on six axes. The database sidecar cannot yet store them all, so section 2 says to put them in `analysis/field_verdicts.json` and `RESULTS.md` meanwhile. This page reports **where those axes objects exist today** and **whether they agree with what this run re-derives from the same raw**. Rows without an axes object are reported as ABSENT, with an exact numerator and denominator - not as a zero score.
